title: Amazon demands Perplexity stop its Comet shopping agent from making purchases on Amazon
summary: Amazon accused Perplexity of violating its terms of service, which forbid automated access, after Perplexity's Comet agent queried Amazon product pages and automated shopping on the site without permission, and sent a legal demand that Comet users' assistants stop operating on Amazon. The dispute turns on whether an agent acting on a user's command must disclose itself: Amazon demanded unambiguous agent identification, while Perplexity argued in its 4 November 2025 response that the assistant is a user proxy that should be indistinguishable from the user.
